records.label: Keqing — Ineffa — Furina — Jean

rotations.label: KQM sample longer rotation with low ER requirements
rotations.notation: Ineffa E > Furina ED Q > Jean EQ > Keqing EQE 5[N1C] > Ineffa Q > Jean tE > Keqing EQE 5[N1C] > Jean tE
assumptions: The final Keqing combo can be shortened by one or two Charged Attacks.

rotations.label: KQM sample shorter rotation for maximum Fanfare uptime
rotations.notation: Ineffa EQ > Furina ED Q > Jean EQ > Keqing EQE 5[N1C] > Jean tE > Keqing EE 5[N1C]
assumptions: The final Keqing combo can be shortened by one or two Charged Attacks.
The source describes this branch as close to 20 seconds as possible rather than an exact duration.

records.label: Keqing — Ineffa — Furina — Xilonen

rotations.label: KQM sample rotation
rotations.notation: (Furina ED) > Ineffa E > Xilonen EQ N2 > Furina Q > Keqing EQE 5[N1C] > Xilonen E N2 > Ineffa Q > Keqing EE 3[N1C]
assumptions: On subsequent rotations, the opening Furina Skill can be moved from the opening position to be performed together with her Burst.

rotations.label: KQM sample rotation for maximum shield uptime
rotations.notation: Ineffa (Q) E > Furina ED Q > Xilonen EQ N2 > Keqing EQE 5[N1C] > Xilonen E N2
assumptions: Use Ineffa's optional Burst whenever it is available.

records.label: Keqing — Ineffa — Aino — Sucrose

rotations.label: KQM sample rotation
rotations.notation: Ineffa E (Q) > Aino EQ > Sucrose ED (Q) > Keqing EQE 5[N1C] > Sucrose N2
assumptions: Use Ineffa's and Sucrose's optional Bursts every other rotation, alternating which character Bursts.
The source describes the rotation as approximately 16 seconds.
Sucrose returns on-field at the end to refresh Viridescent Venerer.
